full_page.content:
1924, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 4 Cont.
Jan. 24 Wm Rhead. (Pel. Bay) Non Cath. Wayword - not doing right by wife and Fam. -
30 Shows determination to do God's will - listening to Earnest Catholic friend's Admonition.
Jan 28 Wm J. Collins Freehold, N. J. enrolled on Dec. Ist as patient in insane hospital Philadelphia, is reported to have written home - a surpassing surprise to mother and friends for xmas
April 13th ... Same W.J.C. now back to work as before sick - since beginning of March.
30 Josephine O'Donnell 206-E. 126 St. Enrolled herself and hus- band - he an inmate of Asylum on Wards Island - October 30th 1922 -- Today reports husband home and mentilly well since Nov. same yr.
Feb 2nd To-day received instruction from P. Provincial
Febr 2nd Patrick Hardiman of 205 E. 114 St. Enrolled crippled mother Mary H. Jan. 14th. Feb. 2nd reports - On Jan. 20th No pain as certificate is laid on ice-box - now goes to holy Mass - before enrollment - was pleading for Fr. Sol. to visit her. Now goes shoping as 20 years ago. She cried with Joy at recovery lives at 245 E. 94 St. N. Y. City
Feb. 3 Mrs. Alice Rogers, a convert, hard of hearing enrolled by Pat- rick Hardiman for year
Margaret Aylword of 1077 3rd Ave. Enrolled her husband Richard Francis A for one year, a year and a half (18 mo) in Ward's Island Asylum.
5 th Madeline Alianiello 20 217 - E. 113 St. has suffered from xema of scalp. 6 years trying every remedy Friends would not doctors wanted to cut of her hair - terribly for itch. etc. Her sister had pleaded most earnestly promising to do anything if God would only indicate.
Page 5 Febr. 9 Joseph York 54 of 1978 - 3rd Ave. N.Y.C. despondently ner- vous over a year wishing to go to hospital for rest - "Go to an asylum," advised Fr. I., "They will not take you in the H., joins S.M.A. with wife and gets along O.K.
